name: paymenter_list_users
description: List users registered in Paymenter with filtering by name/email, pagination, sorting, and relation sideloading.

page.description: Page number to retrieve, starting at 1.

per_page.description: Number of records per page (1-100). Defaults to 15.

sort.description: Sort field. Prefix with hyphen '-' for descending order.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to sideload: properties, orders, services, invoices, tickets, credits, role.

email.description: Filter users by exact or partial email address.
